tasks.title: Concurrency and persistence: threads, Worker.start/stop, reopen on a file

argv:
import sys, time, threading
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from jobq import *
class Clk:
    def __init__(s): s.t=1000.0
    def __call__(s): return s.t
c=Clk()
import tempfile,os
p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'q.db'); q=JobQueue(p); cnt={}; lk=threading.Lock()
def h(pl,x):
    with lk: cnt[pl]=cnt.get(pl,0)+1
    time.sleep(0.003)
[q.enqueue('n',i) for i in range(50)]
w=Worker(q,{'n':h},poll_interval=0.01).start(4); end=time.time()+60
while q.counts()['succeeded']<50 and time.time()<end: time.sleep(0.05)
w.stop(); print(q.counts()['succeeded'], sorted(cnt)==list(range(50)), set(cnt.values()))
